texts.preamble: Hazi Hasan & 2 Ors. vs State Of U.P. Thru Secy. Home & 4 Ors. on 2 August, 2019 Author: Ajai Lamba Bench: Ajai Lamba, Narendra Kumar Johari High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench ?Court No. - 2 Case :- Misc. Bench No. - 7701 of 2008 Petitioner :- Hazi Hasan & 2 Ors. Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru Secy. Home & 4 Ors.
texts.facts: 1. The petition seeks issuance of a writ in the nature of mandamus directing respondent No.4 (Station House Officer, P.S. Kotwali, district Barabanki) not to create hindrance in functioning and carrying business of the petitioners of slaughtering and selling buffaloes' meat in village Alapur, P.S. Kotwali, district Barabanki. In the meantime, it is provided that in case no bye laws has been framed by the Zila Panchayat and there are no statutory rules or valid executive orders for restraining the petitioners for slaughtering and selling the buffalo's meat at the particular place, the petitioners' business shall not be interfered with. " 3. The petitioners are required to make an application under the provisions of the Amendment Act of 2017.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioners has pointed out that there has been a development in so much as the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 provides for making application for grant of licence for slaughtering the buffaloes and selling its meat. Learned counsel contends that in the further development, the petitioners applied for licence on 25.4.2017. However, neither licence has been granted nor the petitioners are being allowed to pursue their profession. Hazi Hasan & 2 Ors. vs State Of U.P. Thru Secy. Home & 4 Ors. on 2 August, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/119669257/ 2 4. Learned counsel for the State Mr. Raj Baksh Singh, however, has pointed out that a new Act, viz Food Safety and Standards (Amendment) Act, 2017 has come into force.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioners has pointed out that there has been a development in so much as the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 provides for making application for grant of licence for slaughtering the buffaloes and selling its meat. Learned counsel contends that in the further development, the petitioners applied for licence on 25.4.2017. However, neither licence has been granted nor the petitioners are being allowed to pursue their profession. Hazi Hasan & 2 Ors. vs State Of U.P. Thru Secy.
